items.title: Europol Warns Crypto Wallets Are 'Primary Risk' for Quantum Attacks
items.desc: The EU police agency expects blockchains to adapt to the threat, while a second report weighs the risk of data stolen now and cracked later.

items.title: Muneeb Ali Pledges IP Transfer to Stacks Endowment in CEO Plan
items.desc: The Stacks Labs chief also promised a two-year roadmap covering Bitcoin privacy and post-quantum technology, plus a public holder call within 30 days.

items.title: Sui’s Hashi to launch with $500M in Bitcoin finance commitments
items.desc: Hashi has more than $500M in commitments ahead of mainnet launch, while Anchorage offers institutions settlement and self-custody.

items.title: Uranium Finance Hacker Who Bought Pokémon and Magic Cards Convicted Over $50M Theft
items.desc: Jonathan Spalletta also spent stolen crypto on a Roman coin marking Julius Caesar's assassination and moon-flown Wright brothers fabric.

items.title: Former PlayStation Exec Slams Sony's Move to Kill Discs: 'What Are You Buying?'
items.desc: Sony plans to cease physical disc production in 2028. A former PlayStation exec claims it has caused reputational damage.

items.title: ESMA gives crypto firms 3 months to exit non-compliant stablecoins
items.desc: ESMA urged EU crypto firms to halt services involving non-MiCA-compliant stablecoins, giving regulators three months to address existing exposures.

items.title: NEAR enters crypto’s top 20 after 140% surge in 30 days
items.desc: NEAR climbed into the top 20 cryptocurrencies by market capitalization, as NEAR Intents surpassed $31 billion in cumulative transaction volume.

items.title: Standard Chartered plans institutional crypto custody in Singapore
items.desc: Standard Chartered plans custody for cryptocurrencies, stablecoins and tokenized assets for institutional and eligible corporate clients in Singapore.

items.title: Greece plans 10% capital gains tax on cryptocurrencies
items.desc: Greece’s draft bill proposes a 10% tax on crypto capital gains, with exemptions for annual gains of up to 500 euros and crypto-to-crypto swaps.

items.title: US Bitcoin ETFs shed $485M in biggest daily outflow since June
items.desc: Bitcoin ETFs erased October’s net inflows with $485 million in withdrawals, while Ether funds logged a seventh straight outflow session.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.desc: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Crypto’s heavy backing of Republicans alienated Democrats: Cuomo
items.desc: Former New York Governor Andrew Cuomo urged the crypto industry to balance its support for Democrats and Republicans if they want federal crypto legislation passed.

items.title: Crypto must cement adoption to withstand US policy shifts: Canton CEO
items.desc: Canton CEO Yuval Rooz compared blockchain adoption to Uber and Airbnb, arguing that widespread adoption could help insulate it from potential policy reversals.

items.title: Hyperliquid Labs-Labeled Wallet Distributes $330 Million in HYPE
items.desc: Five intermediary addresses forwarded the tokens to one wallet, which returned 1.25 million HYPE to staking.

items.title: Samsung to launch USDC transfers on Solana for US Galaxy users
items.desc: The South Korean tech giant said the feature is built into Samsung Wallet, with fiat on- and off-ramps, rather than a separate crypto app.

items.title: Samsung Wallet to Add USDC on Sui in Late October
items.desc: Bastion and Coinbase will custody the balances, while transfers to bank accounts in more than 60 countries will carry separate fees.

items.title: Circle brings USDC, EURC payments to SAP customers through Tereina
items.desc: The partnership with SAP-backed Tereina will let businesses send and receive Circle’s stablecoins from within the financial software they already use.

items.title: Anthropic Launches Haiku 5.5: Its Cheapest and Fastest Claude Model Yet
items.desc: Claude Haiku 5.5 costs about 75% less to run than its predecessor and targets high-volume jobs like summaries and live customer support. It arrives 15 days after Opus 5.5.

items.title: Binance Adds JPMorgan and Eli Lilly bStocks as Margin Collateral
items.desc: Four equity-linked tokens join the collateral lineup, with 50% collateral ratios in Cross Margin and Portfolio Margin and a separate tiered schedule for Portfolio Margin Pro.

items.title: SEC and CFTC Crypto Rules 'Fall Short' of Clarity, Says Rep. French Hill
items.desc: The House Financial Services chairman credited the SEC and CFTC for stepping in after the Clarity Act's collapse but said only "permanent law change" can secure U.S. leadership.

items.title: Tether Signs Deal With Kazakhstan's Central Bank to Explore a Stablecoin and Tokenized Assets
items.desc: Tether, issuer of the USDT stablecoin, will help Kazakhstan's central bank study a tenge-pegged token and put real-world assets on a blockchain.

items.title: Grayscale says crypto ETF market is entering new phase as Zcash ETF tops $1 billion
items.desc: Grayscale's Krista Lynch says SEC listing standards cover about 15 tokens, letting crypto ETF issuers get selective beyond bitcoin and ether.

items.title: Bitcoin Holds Below $84,000 Cost-Basis Level as Only Nine of 125 Top Tokens Rise
items.desc: Bitcoin fell through $84,000 in two legs, the first in the Asia session and the second at the U.S. open, and has not reclaimed it. A Bitfinex research note circulated hours earlier had called that level the market's largest cost-basis cluster. Funding rates sat near zero across OKX, Deribit and

items.title: Ethereum researcher Justin Drake calls for ‘bunker mode’ planning over private key recovery risk
items.desc: Justin Drake recommended moving crypto assets to fresh addresses that keep their public keys hidden behind a hash.

items.title: Trader Frogman Drained of $4 Million on the First Morning of TOKEN2049
items.desc: Onchain records show the tokens left his Solana wallet at 4:14 a.m. Singapore time and were sold in four equal lots over the nine minutes that followed. The trader says he has found no sign of a breach on his phone or email

items.title: US Government Moves $103 Million in Seized Bitcoin and BNB, But Hasn't Said Why
items.desc: Government-labeled wallets sent 833.6 BTC to Coinbase Prime deposit addresses and shuffled 40,285 BNB. No sale is confirmed, but the stash behind it is the largest any government holds in Arkham's ranking.

items.title: ZKsync Opens Prividium Core Code Under Apache 2.0
items.desc: The Sept. 8 release keeps enterprise tools commercial. Matter Labs says the Bundesbank is testing a self-hosted deployment.

items.title: GSR Commits $100 Million to Hare Vault Business
items.desc: The first Aave-powered products will target stablecoins and tokenized gold, with outside investors expected to join GSR in the vaults. Opening dates are still to come.

items.title: Injective’s Meridian Upgrade Expands Controls for Tokenized Assets
items.desc: The mainnet release begins private trading tests, while the broader CypherOS privacy platform is planned for a later chain upgrade.

items.title: BitMine Will Stop Buying ETH at 5% of Supply, Tom Lee Says
items.desc: The company reported 6,016,414 ETH as of Oct. 4, while Lee estimates roughly 100,000 tokens remain before it reaches the ceiling.

items.title: Hyperliquid Confirms Singapore Base but Says It Has No MAS License
items.desc: The FT reports that people familiar with MAS's thinking consider the decentralized venue outside its jurisdiction. Singapore's rules distinguish crypto derivatives on approved exchanges from those offered elsewhere.

items.title: Hunter Biden says LAPTOP market maker should ‘buy it all back and burn it’
items.desc: A commissioned report details thin liquidity and market-maker-linked gains during LAPTOP’s launch.

items.title: NEAR Adds Robinhood Chain to Its Multichain App
items.desc: ETH and USDG swaps use NEAR Intents to handle cross-chain routing, while bridge infrastructure still moves assets between networks.

items.title: Cardano's Programmable Token Standard Goes Live With Issuer Controls
items.desc: Wallets, DEXs and lending protocols need integration changes to handle the assets, whose issuer-selected rules can permit freezes and forced transfers.

items.title: Tether, Kazakhstan cenbank mull tenge stablecoin and asset tokenization
items.desc: The agreement will explore a tenge-backed stablecoin pilot and a framework for tokenizing real-world assets as Kazakhstan expands its digital asset industry.

items.title: House Finance panel chair says regulator actions on crypto ‘fall short’ of CLARITY bill
items.desc: Representative French Hill hopes lawmakers could pass a cryptocurrency market structure bill before the next session of Congress in 2027 as SEC and CFTC actions weren’t sufficient.

items.title: Coplan Stops Short of Mentioning a Polymarket Token at TOKEN2049
items.desc: Traders read a Sunday post as a tease of POLY. Coplan described an onchain asset tied to the company's economics, named no structure and set no date

items.title: Lido Unveils Morpho-Based Lending Protocol for Staking Loops
items.desc: Lido Lend targets a fourth-quarter launch, with collateral screening and reliable exits among its design goals. DAO votes and technical disclosures are still ahead.

items.title: Ledger Launches Wrapped-Bitcoin Loans Through Morpho
items.desc: The wallet app defaults to 50% loan-to-value and charges a 1% borrowing fee, while pledged collateral remains subject to liquidation.

items.title: Coinbase brings global crypto derivatives liquidity to US with Deribit integration
items.desc: US institutions will gain access to Deribit’s options and perpetual futures through Coinbase, with US retail options expected later this year.

items.title: Bitcoin Dips Below $83K as Oil Shock Rattles Markets: What Happens Next?
items.desc: Bitcoin fell sharply as oil topped $101 and the 30-year Treasury yield hit its highest since 2002. The daily chart still leans bullish. The four-hour chart disagrees.

items.title: Bitmine's Relentless Ethereum Buying Is About to End, Tom Lee Says
items.desc: Speaking at Token2049 in Singapore, the chairman said Bitmine is about 100,000 ETH—roughly six to seven weeks—from its 5% cap, setting an end date on a buying spree that made it the world's largest Ethereum treasury.

items.title: Moody’s gives Sky Protocol B3 rating as institutional interest in USDS grows
items.desc: Moody's assigned Sky a B3 issuer rating with a stable outlook, its first rating of a stablecoin protocol. Sky is also rated B- by S&P.

items.title: Moody's Rates Sky B3, Flagging Thin Capital Buffer
items.desc: The stable-outlook rating puts Sky in Moody's speculative-grade category, with roughly $90 million in equity against $10 billion in managed assets.

items.title: Engineer Gets 32 Months for Bitcoin Extortion Plot Against His Own Employer
items.desc: Daniel Rhyne locked his company's IT administrators out of its network and demanded 20 BTC, then worth $750,000, to stop the shutdowns.

items.title: Chasing 100x tokens is game of ‘irrational exuberance,’ says Polymarket CEO
items.desc: Some traders are looking for more predictable prediction market opportunities, rather than playing “hot potato” with the next 100x gem, according to Polymarket’s Shayne Coplan.

items.title: Morning Minute: OKX Raises at $25B From Circle, Ripple, and StanChart
items.desc: OKX raises more, $500M+ in crypto longs liquidated after a late evening selloff, and Abstract calls it quits.

items.title: Crypto card access doesn’t match global demand, Tangem says
items.desc: Crypto card demand can be stronger where access is harder, Tangem says, as it expands its Visa payment offering, allowing users to spend from its self-custodial wallet.

items.title: NEAR’s Polosukhin sees shrinking need for centralized exchanges as onchain tools expand
items.desc: NEAR co-founder Illia Polosukhin said users no longer need centralized exchanges for "a lot" of crypto activity.

items.title: Wall Street wealth creation model is unsustainable for most participants: Hyperliquid CEO
items.desc: Early Wall Street wealth-creation opportunities remain inaccessible to retail participants, but Hyperliquid’s perpetual contracts aim to democratize access, according to its CEO.

items.title: Prosecutors Cite Bitcoin Fog Ruling Against Roman Storm's Venue Challenge
items.desc: The Tornado Cash founder hit back in a tweet, noting FinCEN withdrew a proposed mixer rule over concerns it could chill legitimate activity.

items.title: ‘Old money’ has stronger Bitcoin ‘diamond hands,’ says BingX exec
items.desc: BingX strategy chief Kevin Lee says wealthy investors are taking a longer-term approach to Bitcoin, though family-office crypto exposure remains limited.

items.title: Jito’s JTX plans mobile app this fall, eyes perps integration later this winter
items.desc: Jito’s JTX plans a mobile app, equities feature, and perpetual futures as it expands beyond spot trading on Solana.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs rebound with $119M inflow as Ether extends losses
items.desc: Bitcoin ETFs returned to net inflows with $119 million on Tuesday despite falling prices, while Ether funds reached a six-session outflow streak totaling $408 million.

items.title: Ledger Launches Bitcoin Loans, Letting Holders Borrow Without Selling
items.desc: Unveiled at TOKEN2049 Singapore, the Morpho-powered Crypto Loan feature lets users borrow stablecoins against wrapped Bitcoin while keeping private keys and final approval on their hardware device.

items.title: Bitmine sets 5% Ether supply ‘hard cap’ as accumulation target nears
items.desc: Tom Lee said Bitmine will not accumulate Ether past 5% of the supply, turning the company’s target into a ceiling.

items.title: ‘Every single exchange’ will have to adopt public blockchain infrastructure to compete, Hyperliquid Policy Center CEO says
items.desc: Chervinsky says that beyond regulated perps, onchain markets need to enter the U.S. regulatory perimeter, a step he expects will happen soon.

items.title: Russia clears first crypto exchanges, custodians under new law
items.desc: Russia registered its first crypto exchanges and custodians, including its largest bank, Sberbank, which plans to launch crypto products on Dec. 1.

items.title: DOJ invokes Bitcoin Fog ruling in potential blow to Roman Storm acquittal bid
items.desc: Prosecutors say a recent Bitcoin Fog appeals court ruling supports their argument that Tornado Cash activity in Manhattan was enough to establish venue for parts of Roman Storm’s case in New York.

items.title: Robinhood adds $25 million worth of bitcoin to balance sheet as it deepens crypto push
items.desc: Robinhood SVP Johann Kerbrat says the purchase was intended to signal the company's commitment to the crypto sector.

items.title: Bitcoin briefly slides below $84,000 as crypto long liquidations reach $487 million
items.desc: Crypto liquidations amounted to $555.6 million over the past 24 hours, including $487.2 million in long positions, according to CoinGlass.

items.title: Bitcoin Sinks Below $84,000 in Sudden Sell-Off
items.desc: Coinbase recorded an $83,551 low, while Coinalyze showed $83 million in bitcoin long liquidations over 24 hours.

items.title: Coinbase Pro to return; Deribit integration creates Coinbase Global Exchange
items.desc: Coinbase plans to relaunch Coinbase Pro by year-end and has completed its Deribit integration, creating Coinbase Global Exchange.

items.title: Google Launches Nano Banana 2.1: Better Than Its Predecessor at Half the Price
items.desc: Google's new image model, Nano Banana 2.1, is live. It costs about half as much as its predecessor, but the performance claims come from Google's own tests.

items.title: Circle Welcomes DJ Khaled to 'Team USDC' and Crypto Twitter Is Furious
items.desc: Nothing in Circle's posts announces a sponsorship, but replies dug up Khaled's 2018 SEC settlement over a crypto fraud he promoted. The internet never forgets.

items.title: Someone Scraped 5.6 Billion TikTok Videos and Put the Data on Hugging Face for Free
items.desc: A developer posted metadata for about 5.6 billion public TikTok videos, scraped through the app's private API in a way TikTok's terms prohibit. The free dataset also doubles as a storefront.

items.title: Pudgy Penguins' Ethereum Layer-2 Abstract Is Shutting Down
items.desc: Abstract will shut down Dec. 15, saying a chain focused solely on consumer crypto proved unsustainable, and is urging users to bridge their assets off before then.

items.title: Tether Hit With Lawsuit Over $2.76 Million Stablecoin Freeze
items.desc: The payments firm alleges Tether froze its treasury wallet on its own initiative over a Brazilian investigation it has no connection to—and has profited from the reserves while refusing to release the funds for more than a year.

items.title: Bryan Johnson Spent Millions to Reverse Aging. He Says a Filter Works Better
items.desc: The face of the "Don't Die" movement now says retouching beats therapy for looking young. His transformation over the summer may explain why.

items.title: Another Zcash ETF Is Coming: Winklevoss Twins File for 'WINK'
items.desc: The proposed fund would hold ZEC directly, trade on Nasdaq under "WINK" with Gemini as custodian, and add the Winklevoss twins to a wave of institutional interest in the privacy coin.

items.title: Ethereum Validator Count Falls to 863,000 as Staked ETH Edges Higher
items.desc: Pectra lets operators combine validator balances, reducing network overhead without requiring them to withdraw their ETH.

items.title: Anchorage Digital Buys Routable to Add Corporate Payment Rails
items.desc: Routable will operate under a new brand, with integrated stablecoin and tokenized deposit offerings rolling out over the coming quarters.

items.title: Firelight Begins Writing DeFi Cover Backed By Staked XRP
items.desc: The protocol's first cover positions went to two Sentora vaults, with payouts standing behind 50.2 million XRP staked on Flare. Claims are decided by a five-firm consortium on a three-of-five vote, and the coverage contracts' audits are listed as coming soon.

items.title: Winklevoss group seeks to launch Zcash ETF with 0.25% fee, proposed WINK ticker
items.desc: Winklevoss Asset Services filed for a spot Zcash ETF under ticker WINK, with Gemini as custodian and a 0.25% fee, rivaling Grayscale's ZCSH.

items.title: Bitcoin Falls Asleep, But Privacy Coins Zcash and Monero Are Waking Up
items.desc: Bitcoin and Ethereum barely moved today, but Zcash and Monero are leading the largest coins over the last 24 hours.

items.title: Agora’s OCC Approval Sets Up AUSD Move to a US Trust Bank
items.desc: The planned bank would take over issuance and reserves from Agora’s Bermuda entity, but must meet capital, liquidity and compliance conditions before opening.

items.title: Solana treasury DeFi Development authorizes CHAD preferred stock buyback program
items.desc: Solana treasury firm DeFi Development approved an open-ended program to repurchase CHAD preferred stock if it trades below its $10 par value.

items.title: Brevan Howard to use Ripple Prime for multi-asset brokerage, clearing and financing
items.desc: Ripple Prime will provide prime brokerage, clearing and financing to Brevan Howard, deepening a tie that began with its Ripple investment.

items.title: Ethereum’s Glamsterdam Upgrade Activates on Sepolia
items.desc: The first two upgraded epochs finalized, while early blocks began a gradual gas-limit climb from 60 million toward a 200 million client target.
